extends Node
## Headless self-test: bots fight through every mode and every special move.

var m: Node = null
var fails: Array = []
var step_i: int = 0
const DT: float = 1.0 / 60.0

func _ready() -> void:
	m = get_parent()
	call_deferred("_run")

func check(cond: bool, msg: String) -> void:
	if not cond:
		fails.append(msg)
		push_error("SELFTEST FAIL: " + msg)
	else:
		print("ok: " + msg)

func steps(n: int) -> void:
	for i: int in range(n):
		m.update(DT)

func run_until(pred: Callable, max_s: float) -> bool:
	var n: int = int(max_s / DT)
	for i: int in range(n):
		m.update(DT)
		if pred.call():
			return true
	return false

func _run() -> void:
	print("=== Knuckle Kings selftest ===")
	# --- title
	m.show_title()
	steps(120)
	check(m.cur_screen == "title", "title screen shows")
	check(m.title_fighters.size() == 2, "title has two sparring fighters")
	# --- arcade flow
	m.show_difficulty()
	check(m.cur_screen == "difficulty", "difficulty screen")
	m.difficulty = 1
	m.mode = "arcade"
	m.boss_unlocked = false
	m.p1_choice = 0
	m.show_select()
	check(m.cur_screen == "select", "select screen")
	check(m.preview_fighters.size() == 8, "8 fighters on select (boss locked)")
	m._select_move(0, 1)
	m._select_move(0, 1)
	m._select_confirm(0)
	check(m.cur_screen == "fight", "arcade fight starts after choose")
	check(m.p1_choice == 2, "p1 choice saved (captain)")
	check(m.fighters.size() == 2, "two fighters in fight")
	check(m.ai[0] != null and m.ai[1] != null, "both bots in selftest")
	var ok: bool = run_until(func() -> bool: return m.phase == "fighting", 5.0)
	check(ok, "round intro ends, fighting begins")
	var hit_seen: bool = false
	var ko_seen: bool = false
	var proj_seen: bool = false
	var t0: float = Time.get_ticks_msec()
	for i: int in range(int(200.0 / DT)):
		m.update(DT)
		if m.fighters.size() == 2:
			if m.fighters[0].hp < m.fighters[0].max_hp or m.fighters[1].hp < m.fighters[1].max_hp:
				hit_seen = true
			if m.phase == "ko":
				ko_seen = true
		if m.projectiles.size() > 0:
			proj_seen = true
		if m.phase == "done":
			break
	check(hit_seen, "bots land hits")
	check(ko_seen, "a KO happened")
	check(m.phase == "done", "fight finished (phase done) in %d ms" % int(Time.get_ticks_msec() - t0))
	check(m.cur_screen == "result", "result screen")
	check(m.rounds_won[0] == 2 or m.rounds_won[1] == 2, "someone won 2 rounds: %s" % str(m.rounds_won))
	# --- every fighter: special move lands or spawns a projectile
	for i: int in range(9):
		var d: Dictionary = Roster.FIGHTERS[i]
		m.mode = "versus"
		m._start_fight(i, (i + 1) % 8, true, false)
		run_until(func() -> bool: return m.phase == "fighting", 5.0)
		m.ai[0] = null
		m.fighters[0].is_ai = false
		var f: Fighter = m.fighters[0]
		var o: Fighter = m.fighters[1]
		m.ai[1] = null  # dummy stands
		f.meter = 100.0
		f.pos.x = -60.0
		o.pos.x = 100.0
		steps(3)
		var hp0: float = o.hp
		m.touch.state = {"special": true}
		steps(2)
		m.touch.state = {}
		check(f.attack_id == String(d["special"]), "%s uses special %s" % [d["name"], d["special"]])
		var landed: bool = run_until(func() -> bool: return o.hp < hp0, 2.5)
		check(landed, "%s special (%s) damages opponent" % [d["name"], d["special"]])
		check(f.meter < 100.0, "%s special costs meter" % d["name"])
	# --- projectile clash + jump + block + combo chain
	m._start_fight(2, 5, true, false)  # captain vs volt: both fireballs
	run_until(func() -> bool: return m.phase == "fighting", 5.0)
	m.ai[0] = null
	m.ai[1] = null
	m.fighters[0].is_ai = false
	m.fighters[0].pos.x = -300.0
	m.fighters[1].pos.x = 300.0
	m.fighters[0].meter = 100.0
	m.fighters[1].meter = 100.0
	steps(2)
	m.touch.state = {"special": true}
	m.test_input[1] = {"special": true}
	steps(2)
	m.touch.state = {}
	m.test_input[1] = {}
	var both: bool = run_until(func() -> bool: return m.projectiles.size() >= 2, 1.0)
	check(both, "two projectiles in the air")
	var clashed: bool = run_until(func() -> bool: return m.projectiles.size() == 0, 2.0)
	check(clashed, "projectiles clash and vanish")
	# block test
	m.fighters[0].pos.x = -40.0
	m.fighters[1].pos.x = 80.0
	m.test_input[1] = {"block": true}
	steps(3)
	var hp1: float = m.fighters[1].hp
	m.touch.state = {"punch": true}
	steps(2)
	m.touch.state = {}
	run_until(func() -> bool: return m.fighters[0].state == "idle", 1.0)
	check(m.fighters[1].hp == hp1, "blocked jab does no damage")
	check(m.fighters[1].state in ["block", "idle"], "defender blocked (state %s)" % m.fighters[1].state)
	# combo chain: jab -> cross -> upper
	m.test_input[1] = {}
	m.fighters[1].set_state("idle")
	m.fighters[1].blocking = false
	m.fighters[0].pos.x = -40.0
	m.fighters[1].pos.x = 70.0
	steps(2)
	var seen: Array = []
	for k: int in range(90):
		m.touch.state = {"punch": (k % 6) < 2}
		m.update(DT)
		if m.fighters[0].attack_id != "" and (seen.is_empty() or seen[-1] != m.fighters[0].attack_id):
			seen.append(m.fighters[0].attack_id)
	m.touch.state = {}
	check("jab" in seen and "cross" in seen, "punch chain jab->cross (%s)" % str(seen))
	check(m.fighters[0].combo_count >= 2 or "upper" in seen, "combo counter counted hits (%d)" % m.fighters[0].combo_count)
	# jump + flying kick
	m.fighters[0].set_state("idle")
	m.fighters[0].pos.x = -120.0
	m.fighters[1].pos.x = 60.0
	m.touch.state = {"up": true, "right": true}
	steps(2)
	m.touch.state = {"kick": true}
	steps(2)
	m.touch.state = {}
	check(m.fighters[0].attack_id == "flykick", "flying kick in the air")
	run_until(func() -> bool: return m.fighters[0].on_ground and m.fighters[0].state == "idle", 2.0)
	# sweep knocks down
	m.fighters[1].set_state("idle")
	m.fighters[1].pos.x = 40.0
	m.fighters[0].pos.x = -60.0
	m.touch.state = {"down": true}
	steps(3)
	m.touch.state = {"down": true, "kick": true}
	steps(2)
	m.touch.state = {}
	var down: bool = run_until(func() -> bool: return m.fighters[1].state in ["launched", "down"], 1.5)
	check(down, "sweep knocks opponent down (state %s)" % m.fighters[1].state)
	var up: bool = run_until(func() -> bool: return m.fighters[1].state == "idle", 4.0)
	check(up, "knocked-down fighter gets up")
	# pause
	m._show_pause()
	check(m.paused, "pause works")
	steps(10)
	m._hide_pause()
	check(not m.paused, "unpause works")
	# timer: time runs out -> round ends
	m.timer = 0.5
	run_until(func() -> bool: return m.phase == "roundend", 2.0)
	check(m.phase == "roundend", "TIME! ends the round")
	# --- training mode
	m.mode = "training"
	m._start_fight(0, 3, true, true)
	run_until(func() -> bool: return m.phase == "fighting", 5.0)
	m.dummy_mode = 1
	steps(int(8.0 / DT))
	check(m.phase == "fighting", "training keeps fighting (no KO)")
	check(m.hud.infinite_time, "training has no timer")
	# --- boss unlock + 2 player select
	m.boss_unlocked = true
	m.mode = "versus"
	m.show_select()
	check(m.preview_fighters.size() == 9, "boss playable after unlock")
	m._select_confirm(0)
	check(m._active_player() == 1, "player 2 picks next")
	m.select_cursor[1] = 8
	m._select_confirm(1)
	check(m.cur_screen == "fight" and m.fighters[1].data["id"] == "king", "2P fight with King Knuckle")
	check(m.fighters[1].max_hp == 150.0, "boss has 150 hp")
	run_until(func() -> bool: return m.phase == "fighting", 5.0)
	m.ai[0] = FighterAI.new(m.fighters[0], 0.8)
	m.ai[1] = FighterAI.new(m.fighters[1], 0.8)
	run_until(func() -> bool: return m.phase == "done", 220.0)
	check(m.phase == "done", "2P bot fight finishes")
	# --- street brawl
	m.start_street(0)
	check(m.cur_screen == "fight" and m.street_state == "walk", "street mode starts")
	check(m.peds.size() == 6, "6 pedestrians on the street")
	check(m.hud.street and not m.hud.show_p2, "street HUD: score, no enemy bar")
	# walk right for a while
	m.test_input[0] = {"right": true}
	steps(int(2.0 / DT))
	m.test_input[0] = {}
	check(m.player.pos.x > -1700.0, "player walks down the street (x=%.0f)" % m.player.pos.x)
	# bring a ped next to us and taunt
	var ped: Fighter = m.peds[0]
	ped.pos.x = m.player.pos.x + 150.0
	ped.pos.y = 0.0
	steps(2)
	m.test_input[0] = {"special": true}
	steps(2)
	m.test_input[0] = {}
	check(m.street_state == "taunt" and m.street_target == ped, "taunt starts a brawl with the nearest ped (%s)" % m.street_state)
	check(m.player.bubble_t > 0.0, "player speech bubble shown")
	var cloud: bool = run_until(func() -> bool: return m.street_state == "cloud", 3.0)
	check(cloud, "dust cloud brawl phase")
	check(m.player.hidden_in_cloud and ped.hidden_in_cloud, "both fighters hidden in the cloud")
	var fight: bool = run_until(func() -> bool: return m.street_state == "fighting", 4.0)
	check(fight, "real fight begins after the cloud")
	check(m.hud.show_p2 and m.hud.p2 == ped and m.ai[1] != null, "enemy bar + AI active")
	check(not m.player.hidden_in_cloud and not ped.hidden_in_cloud, "fighters visible again")
	# win it quickly
	ped.hp = 1.0
	m.ai[1] = null
	ped.pos.x = m.player.pos.x + 90.0
	m.player.pos.y = 0.0
	ped.pos.y = 0.0
	ped.set_state("idle")
	m.player.set_state("idle")
	m.player.facing = 1
	steps(2)
	m.test_input[0] = {"punch": true}
	steps(3)
	m.test_input[0] = {}
	var ko: bool = run_until(func() -> bool: return m.street_state == "ko", 2.0)
	check(ko, "street KO (ped hp %.1f, state %s)" % [ped.hp, m.street_state])
	var won: bool = run_until(func() -> bool: return m.street_state == "won", 3.0)
	check(won, "won state")
	check(m.street_score == 1 and m.hud.street_score == 1, "score counts the brawl")
	var back: bool = run_until(func() -> bool: return m.street_state == "walk", 4.0)
	check(back, "back to walking after the win")
	check(bool(m.street_wander[ped]["leaving"]), "beaten ped walks away")
	check(m.player.opponent == null and not m.hud.show_p2, "player free again, enemy bar hidden")
	# boss shows up at 5 wins
	m.street_score = 5
	steps(5)
	check(m._ped_with_id(8) != null, "King Knuckle appears at 5 wins")
	# lose a brawl -> result screen
	var ped2: Fighter = null
	for f: Fighter in m.peds:
		if f != ped and not bool(m.street_wander[f]["leaving"]) and f.data["id"] != "king":
			ped2 = f
			break
	ped2.pos.x = m.player.pos.x + 120.0
	ped2.pos.y = 0.0
	m.street_wander[ped2]["tx"] = ped2.pos.x
	steps(2)
	m.test_input[0] = {"special": true}
	steps(2)
	m.test_input[0] = {}
	check(m.street_target == ped2, "second brawl targets the next ped")
	run_until(func() -> bool: return m.street_state == "fighting", 6.0)
	m.player.hp = 1.0
	var lost: bool = run_until(func() -> bool: return m.street_state == "lost", 30.0)
	check(lost, "losing a brawl -> lost state")
	var res: bool = run_until(func() -> bool: return m.cur_screen == "result", 4.0)
	check(res, "street result screen")
	# --- title again
	m.show_title()
	steps(30)
	check(m.cur_screen == "title", "back to title")
	print("=== selftest done: %d failures ===" % fails.size())
	for f: String in fails:
		print("  FAIL " + f)
	get_tree().quit(0 if fails.is_empty() else 1)

class_name Hud
extends Control
## Health bars, meters, timer, round dots, announcements, combo counter.

var p1: Fighter = null
var p2: Fighter = null
var timer: float = 99.0
var rounds_won: Array = [0, 0]
var font: Font
var font2: Font
var announce: String = ""
var announce_t: float = 0.0
var announce_life: float = 0.0
var announce_color: Color = Color.WHITE
var shown_hp: Array = [100.0, 100.0]
var combo_show: Array = [0.0, 0.0]
var combo_val: Array = [0, 0]
var training: bool = false
var infinite_time: bool = false
var t: float = 0.0
var street: bool = false
var street_score: int = 0
var street_hint: bool = true
var show_p2: bool = true

func _ready() -> void:
	font = load("res://assets/fonts/bangers.ttf")
	font2 = load("res://assets/fonts/fredoka700.ttf")
	mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)

func say(text: String, life: float = 1.2, color: Color = Color(1, 0.9, 0.3)) -> void:
	announce = text
	announce_t = 0.0
	announce_life = life
	announce_color = color

func tick(dt: float) -> void:
	t += dt
	announce_t += dt
	if p1 and p2:
		shown_hp[0] = lerpf(shown_hp[0], p1.hp, 1.0 - exp(-dt * 6.0))
		shown_hp[1] = lerpf(shown_hp[1], p2.hp, 1.0 - exp(-dt * 6.0))
		for i: int in range(2):
			var f: Fighter = p1 if i == 0 else p2
			if f.combo_count >= 2 and f.combo_timer > 0.0:
				combo_val[i] = f.combo_count
				combo_show[i] = 1.0
			else:
				combo_show[i] = maxf(0.0, combo_show[i] - dt * 2.0)
	queue_redraw()

func _text_c(f: Font, text: String, p: Vector2, fs: int, c: Color, outline: bool = true, align: int = 0) -> void:
	var w: float = f.get_string_size(text, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, fs).x
	var off: Vector2 = p
	if align == 0:
		off.x -= w * 0.5
	elif align == 1:
		off.x -= w
	if outline:
		for ox: int in range(-1, 2):
			for oy: int in range(-1, 2):
				if ox != 0 or oy != 0:
					draw_string(f, off + Vector2(ox * 3, oy * 3), text, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, fs, Color(0.08, 0.05, 0.12))
	draw_string(f, off, text, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, fs, c)

func _draw() -> void:
	if p1 == null or p2 == null:
		return
	var vs: Vector2 = get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size
	var cx: float = vs.x * 0.5
	var top: float = 24.0
	var bar_w: float = minf(470.0, vs.x * 0.38)
	var bar_h: float = 34.0
	for i: int in range(2):
		if i == 1 and not show_p2:
			continue
		var f: Fighter = p1 if i == 0 else p2
		var dir: float = 1.0 if i == 0 else -1.0
		var x0: float = cx - 80.0 if i == 0 else cx + 80.0
		var rect: Rect2 = Rect2(x0 - bar_w if i == 0 else x0, top, bar_w, bar_h)
		# frame
		draw_rect(Rect2(rect.position - Vector2(5, 5), rect.size + Vector2(10, 10)), Color(0.08, 0.05, 0.12))
		draw_rect(rect, Color(0.25, 0.08, 0.1))
		var frac: float = clampf(f.hp / f.max_hp, 0.0, 1.0)
		var sfrac: float = clampf(shown_hp[i] / f.max_hp, 0.0, 1.0)
		var hp_c: Color = Color(0.3, 0.95, 0.35) if frac > 0.5 else (Color(1.0, 0.8, 0.2) if frac > 0.25 else Color(1.0, 0.3, 0.3))
		# lag bar
		var lag_w: float = bar_w * sfrac
		var lag_r: Rect2 = Rect2(rect.position.x + (bar_w - lag_w if i == 0 else 0.0), rect.position.y, lag_w, bar_h)
		draw_rect(lag_r, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.6))
		var w: float = bar_w * frac
		var hr: Rect2 = Rect2(rect.position.x + (bar_w - w if i == 0 else 0.0), rect.position.y, w, bar_h)
		draw_rect(hr, hp_c)
		draw_rect(Rect2(hr.position, Vector2(hr.size.x, 10)), Color(1, 1, 1, 0.35))
		# ticks
		for k: int in range(1, 10):
			var tx: float = rect.position.x + bar_w * k / 10.0
			draw_line(Vector2(tx, rect.position.y), Vector2(tx, rect.position.y + bar_h), Color(0, 0, 0, 0.18), 2.0)
		# name
		var name_txt: String = String(f.data["name"])
		_text_c(font, name_txt, Vector2(rect.position.x + (4.0 if i == 0 else bar_w - 4.0), top + bar_h + 32.0), 30, Color.WHITE, true, 2 if i == 0 else 1)
		# round dots
		for k: int in range(2):
			var dx: float = rect.position.x + (bar_w - 20.0 - k * 30.0 if i == 0 else 20.0 + k * 30.0)
			var won: bool = int(rounds_won[i]) > k
			draw_circle(Vector2(dx, top + bar_h + 24.0), 12.0, Color(0.08, 0.05, 0.12))
			draw_circle(Vector2(dx, top + bar_h + 24.0), 9.0, Color(1.0, 0.85, 0.2) if won else Color(0.3, 0.3, 0.4))
		# special meter
		var m_w: float = bar_w * 0.6
		var m_h: float = 14.0
		var mr: Rect2 = Rect2(rect.position.x + (bar_w - m_w if i == 0 else 0.0), top + bar_h + 42.0, m_w, m_h)
		draw_rect(Rect2(mr.position - Vector2(3, 3), mr.size + Vector2(6, 6)), Color(0.08, 0.05, 0.12))
		draw_rect(mr, Color(0.15, 0.15, 0.25))
		var mf: float = f.meter / 100.0
		var mw: float = m_w * mf
		var acc: Color = f.data["accent"]
		var full: bool = f.meter >= 50.0
		var glow: Color = acc.lerp(Color.WHITE, 0.4 + 0.4 * sin(t * 10.0)) if full else acc.darkened(0.2)
		draw_rect(Rect2(mr.position.x + (m_w - mw if i == 0 else 0.0), mr.position.y, mw, m_h), glow)
		draw_line(Vector2(mr.position.x + m_w * 0.5, mr.position.y), Vector2(mr.position.x + m_w * 0.5, mr.position.y + m_h), Color(0.08, 0.05, 0.12), 3.0)
		if full:
			_text_c(font, "SPECIAL READY!", Vector2(mr.position.x + (m_w if i == 0 else 0.0) + (-6.0 if i == 0 else 6.0), mr.position.y + 13.0), 18, Color(1, 1, 1), true, 1 if i == 0 else 2)
		# combo
		if combo_show[i] > 0.0 and combo_val[i] >= 2:
			var cxp: float = 120.0 if i == 0 else vs.x - 120.0
			var s: float = 1.0 + 0.15 * sin(t * 20.0)
			_text_c(font, "%d HITS!" % combo_val[i], Vector2(cxp, 220.0), int(54.0 * s), Color(1.0, 0.6, 0.1), true, 0)
			if combo_val[i] >= 5:
				_text_c(font, "AWESOME!", Vector2(cxp, 262.0), 30, Color(1.0, 0.9, 0.3), true, 0)
	# timer / street score
	if street:
		_text_c(font, "BRAWLS WON", Vector2(cx, top + 22.0), 22, Color.WHITE)
		_text_c(font, str(street_score), Vector2(cx, top + 72.0), 60, Color(1.0, 0.85, 0.2))
		if not show_p2 and street_hint:
			_text_c(font2, "Walk up to someone and press TAUNT to start a brawl!", Vector2(cx, vs.y - 18.0), 20, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.85))
		return
	draw_circle(Vector2(cx, top + 32.0), 52.0, Color(0.08, 0.05, 0.12))
	draw_circle(Vector2(cx, top + 32.0), 46.0, Color(0.95, 0.85, 0.2) if timer > 10.0 or infinite_time else Color(1.0, 0.35, 0.3))
	var tt: String = "∞" if infinite_time else str(int(ceil(timer)))
	_text_c(font, tt, Vector2(cx, top + 50.0), 48, Color(0.1, 0.05, 0.12), false)
	# announcement
	if announce != "" and announce_t < announce_life:
		var f: float = announce_t / announce_life
		var pop: float = 1.0 + 0.8 * maxf(0.0, 1.0 - announce_t * 5.0)
		var alpha: float = 1.0 if f < 0.75 else 1.0 - (f - 0.75) / 0.25
		var fs: int = int(120.0 * pop)
		var c: Color = announce_color
		c.a = alpha
		var y: float = vs.y * 0.42
		var w: float = font.get_string_size(announce, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, fs).x
		for ox: int in range(-2, 3):
			for oy: int in range(-2, 3):
				draw_string(font, Vector2(cx - w * 0.5 + ox * 3, y + oy * 3), announce, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, fs, Color(0.08, 0.05, 0.12, alpha))
		draw_string(font, Vector2(cx - w * 0.5, y + 6), announce, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, fs, Color(c.r * 0.5, c.g * 0.5, c.b * 0.5, alpha))
		draw_string(font, Vector2(cx - w * 0.5, y), announce, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, fs, c)
	if training:
		_text_c(font2, "TRAINING: hits reset health. P / Esc = pause", Vector2(cx, vs.y - 18.0), 18, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.7))

		"select":

func _parse_args() -> void:
	for a: String in OS.get_cmdline_user_args():
		if a.begins_with("--screen="):
			cmd_screen = a.substr(9)
		if a == "--selftest":
			selftest_mode = true
		if a == "--check":
			var bad: int = 0
			for fn: String in DirAccess.get_files_at("res://scripts"):
				if fn.ends_with(".gd"):
					var sc: Variant = load("res://scripts/" + fn)
					if sc == null or not (sc as Script).can_instantiate() and fn != "ui.gd" and fn != "roster.gd":
						print("BAD: " + fn)
						bad += 1
					else:
						print("compiled: " + fn)
			print("check done, bad=%d" % bad)
			get_tree().quit(bad)
			cmd_screen = "none"
			selftest_mode = true
			return
	if OS.has_feature("web"):
		var h: Variant = JavaScriptBridge.eval("location.hash", true)
		if h is String and (h as String).begins_with("#"):
			var s: String = (h as String).substr(1)
			if s != "":

	bottom.add_child(prev)

	bottom.add_child(go)

	bottom.add_child(nxt)

	back.pressed.connect(func() -> void: sfx.play("click"); show_title())

	for i: int in range(n):

		btn.focus_mode = Control.FOCUS_NONE
		btn.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(130, 260)
		btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("normal", StyleBoxEmpty.new())
		btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("hover", StyleBoxEmpty.new())
		btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("pressed", StyleBoxEmpty.new())
		btn.add_theme_stylebox_override("focus", StyleBoxEmpty.new())
		var idx: int = i
		btn.pressed.connect(func() -> void:
			var p: int = _active_player()
			if select_cursor[p] == idx:
				_select_confirm(p)
			else:
				select_cursor[p] = idx
				sfx.play("click"))
		btn.name = "card%d" % i
		screen_root.add_child(btn)
		var nl: Label = UI.label(String(Roster.FIGHTERS[i]["name"]).split(" ")[0] if String(Roster.FIGHTERS[i]["name"]).length() > 9 else String(Roster.FIGHTERS[i]["name"]), 20, Color.WHITE, true, 4)
		nl.name = "name%d" % i
		nl.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(150, 30)
		screen_root.add_child(nl)

func _select_title() -> String:
	match mode:
		"versus": return "2 PLAYERS — CHOOSE YOUR FIGHTERS"
		"training": return "TRAINING — CHOOSE YOUR FIGHTER"
		"street": return "STREET BRAWL — CHOOSE YOUR FIGHTER"
	return "ARCADE — CHOOSE YOUR FIGHTER"

func _active_player() -> int:
	if mode == "versus" and select_locked[0]:
		return 1
	return 0

func _select_move(p: int, d: int) -> void:
	if select_locked[p]:
		return
	select_cursor[p] = posmod(select_cursor[p] + d, roster_count())
	sfx.play("click", -4.0)
	_select_refresh()

func _select_refresh() -> void:
	if cur_screen != "select":
		return
	var p: int = _active_player()
	var d: Dictionary = Roster.FIGHTERS[select_cursor[p]]
	var info: Label = select_ui["info"]
	var who: String = "PLAYER 2" if p == 1 else "PLAYER 1"
	info.text = "%s: %s — %s   ·   Special: %s" % [who, d["name"], d["tag"], d["special_name"]]
	(select_ui["title"] as Label).text = _select_title()

func _select_confirm(p: int) -> void:
	if select_locked[p]:
		return
	select_locked[p] = true
	sfx.play("select")
	if p == 0:
		p1_choice = select_cursor[0]
		_save()
	else:
		p2_choice = select_cursor[1]
	if mode == "versus":
		if not select_locked[1]:
			if select_cursor[1] == select_cursor[0]:
				select_cursor[1] = posmod(select_cursor[0] + 1, roster_count())
			_select_refresh()
			return
		_start_fight(p1_choice, p2_choice, false, false)
	elif mode == "training":
		var opp: int = randi() % 8
		_start_fight(p1_choice, opp, true, true)
	elif mode == "street":
		start_street(p1_choice)
	else:
		_arcade_build()
		_start_fight(p1_choice, arcade_ladder[0], true, false)

func _arcade_build() -> void:
	arcade_ladder.clear()
	var pool: Array = []
	for i: int in range(8):
		if i != p1_choice:
			pool.append(i)
	pool.shuffle()
	for i: int in pool:
		arcade_ladder.append(i)
	arcade_ladder.append(8)  # boss last
	arcade_pos = 0
	streak = 0

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ fight
func _clear_fight() -> void:
	for f: Node in fighters:
		f.queue_free()
	fighters.clear()
	for f: Node in peds:
		if is_instance_valid(f) and not f.is_queued_for_deletion():
			f.queue_free()
	peds.clear()
	street_wander.clear()
	player = null
	street_target = null
	hud.street = false
	hud.show_p2 = true
	touch.special_label = "SPECIAL"
	for p: Node in projectiles:
		p.queue_free()
	projectiles.clear()
	fx.clear()
	ai = [null, null]
	phase = "none"
	paused = false

func _start_fight(a: int, b: int, p2_is_ai: bool, training: bool) -> void:
	_clear_screen()
	_clear_fight()
	cur_screen = "fight"
	var st: Dictionary = Roster.STAGES[randi() % 4]
	if mode == "arcade" and arcade_pos == arcade_ladder.size() - 1:
		st = Roster.STAGES[4]
	elif mode == "arcade":
		st = Roster.STAGES[arcade_pos % 4]
	if st["id"] == last_stage_id and mode != "arcade":
		st = Roster.STAGES[(Roster.STAGES.find(st) + 1) % 4]
	if cmd_screen.begins_with("stage-"):
		st = Roster.stage_by_id(cmd_screen.substr(6))
	last_stage_id = st["id"]
	stage.setup(st)
	for i: int in range(2):
		var f: Fighter = Fighter.new()
		f.setup(Roster.FIGHTERS[a if i == 0 else b], i)
		world.add_child(f)
		fighters.append(f)
	fighters[0].opponent = fighters[1]
	fighters[1].opponent = fighters[0]
	fighters[1].is_ai = p2_is_ai
	var diff: float = [0.25, 0.55, 0.85][difficulty]
	if mode == "arcade":
		diff = clampf(diff + arcade_pos * 0.05, 0.1, 1.0)
		if arcade_pos == arcade_ladder.size() - 1:
			diff = minf(1.0, diff + 0.15)
	if training:
		diff = 0.3
	if p2_is_ai:
		ai[1] = FighterAI.new(fighters[1], diff)
	if selftest_mode:
		ai[0] = FighterAI.new(fighters[0], 0.7)
		fighters[0].is_ai = true
	rounds_won = [0, 0]
	round_no = 1
	hud.p1 = fighters[0]
	hud.p2 = fighters[1]
	hud.rounds_won = rounds_won
	hud.training = training
	hud.infinite_time = training
	hud.visible = true
	touch.enabled = touch_seen
	touch.queue_redraw()
	sfx.play_music(String(st["music"]))
	_start_round()

func _start_round() -> void:
	for p: Node in projectiles:
		p.queue_free()
	projectiles.clear()
	fx.clear()
	fighters[0].reset_round(-260.0, 1)
	fighters[1].reset_round(260.0, -1)
	hud.shown_hp = [fighters[0].max_hp, fighters[1].max_hp]
	timer = ROUND_TIME
	hud.timer = timer
	phase = "intro"
	phase_t = 0.0
	slowmo = 1.0
	hitstop = 0.0
	var is_final: bool = rounds_won[0] == 1 and rounds_won[1] == 1
	hud.say("FINAL ROUND" if is_final else "ROUND %d" % round_no, 1.3, Color(1, 0.9, 0.3))
	sfx.play("ding")

func _end_round(winner: int) -> void:
	phase = "roundend"
	phase_t = 0.0
	if winner >= 0:
		rounds_won[winner] += 1
		stage.hype = 1.0
		if fighters[winner].hp >= fighters[winner].max_hp:
			hud.say("PERFECT!", 1.6, Color(0.4, 1.0, 0.6))
			sfx.play("meter")
		else:
			hud.say("%s WINS!" % fighters[winner].data["name"], 1.6, Color(1, 0.9, 0.3))
		fighters[winner].set_state("win")
		var loser: Fighter = fighters[1 - winner]
		if loser.state != "ko":
			loser.set_state("lose")
		sfx.play("cheer")
		fx.confetti(fighters[winner].pos + Vector2(0, -200), 40)
	else:
		hud.say("DRAW!", 1.4, Color(0.8, 0.8, 0.9))
		for f: Fighter in fighters:
			f.set_state("lose")

func _fight_over(winner: int) -> void:
	phase = "done"
	result_winner = winner
	sfx.play_music("music_win" if (winner == 0 or mode == "versus") else "music_lose", false)
	if mode == "arcade":
		if winner == 0:
			streak += 1
			best_streak = maxi(best_streak, streak)
			arcade_pos += 1
			if arcade_pos >= arcade_ladder.size():
				arcade_wins += 1
				boss_unlocked = true
				_save()
				_show_result("CHAMPION!!!", "You beat KING KNUCKLE! King Knuckle is now playable!", true)
				fx.confetti(Vector2(0, -400), 160)
				return
			_save()
			_show_result("YOU WIN!", "Next up: %s" % Roster.FIGHTERS[arcade_ladder[arcade_pos]]["name"], false)
		else:
			_save()
			_show_result("YOU LOSE!", "Try again, champ!", false)
	elif mode == "versus":
		_show_result("PLAYER %d WINS!" % (winner + 1), "%s is the Knuckle King!" % fighters[winner].data["name"], false)
	else:
		_show_result("TRAINING OVER", "", false)

func _keys_p1() -> Dictionary:
	var alt_ok: bool = mode != "versus"
	return {
		"left": Input.is_physical_key_pressed(KEY_A) or (alt_ok and Input.is_physical_key_pressed(KEY_LEFT)),
		"right": Input.is_physical_key_pressed(KEY_D) or (alt_ok and Input.is_physical_key_pressed(KEY_RIGHT)),
		"up": Input.is_physical_key_pressed(KEY_W) or (alt_ok and Input.is_physical_key_pressed(KEY_UP)),
		"down": Input.is_physical_key_pressed(KEY_S) or (alt_ok and Input.is_physical_key_pressed(KEY_DOWN)),
		"punch": Input.is_physical_key_pressed(KEY_J) or Input.is_physical_key_pressed(KEY_Z) or (alt_ok and Input.is_physical_key_pressed(KEY_SPACE)),
		"kick": Input.is_physical_key_pressed(KEY_K) or Input.is_physical_key_pressed(KEY_X),
		"special": Input.is_physical_key_pressed(KEY_L) or Input.is_physical_key_pressed(KEY_C),
		"block": Input.is_physical_key_pressed(KEY_I) or Input.is_physical_key_pressed(KEY_V) or Input.is_physical_key_pressed(KEY_SHIFT) and not Input.is_physical_key_pressed(KEY_SLASH),
	}

func _keys_p2() -> Dictionary:
	return {
		"left": Input.is_physical_key_pressed(KEY_LEFT),
		"right": Input.is_physical_key_pressed(KEY_RIGHT),
		"up": Input.is_physical_key_pressed(KEY_UP),
		"down": Input.is_physical_key_pressed(KEY_DOWN),
		"punch": Input.is_physical_key_pressed(KEY_KP_1) or Input.is_physical_key_pressed(KEY_COMMA),
		"kick": Input.is_physical_key_pressed(KEY_KP_2) or Input.is_physical_key_pressed(KEY_PERIOD),
		"special": Input.is_physical_key_pressed(KEY_KP_3) or Input.is_physical_key_pressed(KEY_SLASH),
		"block": Input.is_physical_key_pressed(KEY_KP_0) or Input.is_physical_key_pressed(KEY_KP_ENTER),
	}

func _merge(a: Dictionary, b: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
	var r: Dictionary = {}
	for k: String in INPUT_KEYS:
		r[k] = bool(a.get(k, false)) or bool(b.get(k, false))
	return r

func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
	if event is InputEventScreenTouch and (event as InputEventScreenTouch).pressed:
		if not touch_seen:
			touch_seen = true
			if cur_screen == "fight":
				touch.enabled = true
				touch.queue_redraw()
	if event is InputEventKey and (event as InputEventKey).pressed and not (event as InputEventKey).echo:
		var k: Key = (event as InputEventKey).physical_keycode
		if cur_screen == "fight":
			if k == KEY_P or k == KEY_ESCAPE:
				if paused:
					_hide_pause()
				else:
					_show_pause()
		elif cur_screen == "select":
			if k == KEY_LEFT or k == KEY_A:
				_select_move(_active_player(), -1)
			elif k == KEY_RIGHT or k == KEY_D:
				_select_move(_active_player(), 1)
			elif k in [KEY_ENTER, KEY_SPACE, KEY_J, KEY_Z, KEY_KP_1, KEY_KP_ENTER]:
				_select_confirm(_active_player())
			elif k == KEY_ESCAPE:
				show_title()
		elif cur_screen == "title":
			if k == KEY_ENTER or k == KEY_SPACE:
				sfx.play("select")
				show_difficulty()
		elif cur_screen == "result":
			if k == KEY_ENTER or k == KEY_SPACE:
				for c: Node in screen_root.find_children("*", "Button", true, false):
					(c as Button).emit_signal("pressed")
					break

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ loop
func _process(dt: float) -> void:
	if selftest_mode:
		return
	update(minf(dt, 0.05))

func update(dt: float) -> void:
	title_t += dt
	if touch.pause_pressed:
		touch.pause_pressed = false
		if cur_screen == "fight":
			if paused:
				_hide_pause()
			else:
				_show_pause()
	match cur_screen:
		"title", "select", "difficulty", "howto":
			_update_menu(dt)
		"fight", "result":
			if mode == "street":
				_update_street(dt)
			else:
				_update_fight(dt)

func _update_menu(dt: float) -> void:
	stage.tick(dt)
	fx.tick(dt)
	if cur_screen == "title":
		for f: Fighter in title_fighters:
			# simple sparring choreography
			f.prev_input = f.input
			var inp: Dictionary = {}
			for k: String in INPUT_KEYS:
				inp[k] = false
			var ph: float = fmod(title_t + f.player_index * 1.7, 3.4)
			if ph < 0.05 or (ph > 0.3 and ph < 0.35) or (ph > 0.6 and ph < 0.65):
				inp["punch"] = true
			elif ph > 1.2 and ph < 1.25:
				inp["kick"] = true
			elif ph > 2.0 and ph < 2.05:
				inp["up"] = true
			elif ph > 2.7 and ph < 2.75:
				inp["down"] = true
				inp["kick"] = true
			f.input = inp
			f.tick(dt)
			f.pos.x = -470.0 if f.player_index == 0 else 470.0
			if f.hp < f.max_hp:
				f.hp = f.max_hp
		_check_hits(title_fighters, dt, true)
		var lab: Label = screen_root.find_child("Title", true, false) as Label
		if lab:
			lab.scale = Vector2.ONE * (1.0 + 0.03 * sin(title_t * 4.0))
			lab.pivot_offset = lab.size * 0.5
	elif cur_screen == "select":
		var p: int = _active_player()
		for i: int in range(preview_fighters.size()):
			var f: Fighter = preview_fighters[i]
			f.prev_input = f.input
			var inp: Dictionary = {}
			for k: String in INPUT_KEYS:
				inp[k] = false
			var chosen: bool = i == select_cursor[0] or (mode == "versus" and i == select_cursor[1] and select_locked[0])
			if chosen:
				if f.state == "idle" and fmod(title_t + i, 1.6) < 0.05:
					inp["punch"] = true
				f.scale = f.scale.lerp(Vector2(1.0, 1.0), 1.0 - exp(-dt * 10.0))
			else:
				f.scale = f.scale.lerp(Vector2(0.7, 0.7), 1.0 - exp(-dt * 10.0))
			f.input = inp
			f.facing = 1
			f.tick(dt)
			f.position = Vector2(f.pos.x, -40 + (-30 if chosen else 0))
			f.pos.y = 0.0
		# position tap buttons over cards (screen coords)
		var vs: Vector2 = screen_root.size
		var n: int = preview_fighters.size()
		for i: int in range(n):
			var btn: Control = screen_root.get_node_or_null("card%d" % i) as Control
			if btn:
				var f: Fighter = preview_fighters[i]
				var sp: Vector2 = _world_to_screen(Vector2(f.pos.x, -40))
				btn.position = sp + Vector2(-65, -240)
				var nl: Control = screen_root.get_node_or_null("name%d" % i) as Control
				if nl:
					nl.position = sp + Vector2(-75, 8)
	elif cur_screen == "difficulty" or cur_screen == "howto":
		pass
	cam.position = Vector2(0, -250)
	stage.cam = cam.position
	cam.zoom = Vector2.ONE

func _world_to_screen(p: Vector2) -> Vector2:
	var vs: Vector2 = get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size
	return (p - cam.position) * cam.zoom + vs * 0.5

func _update_fight(dt: float) -> void:
	if fighters.size() < 2:
		return
	if paused:
		touch.queue_redraw()
		return
	stage.tick(dt)
	phase_t += dt
	var sdt: float = dt * slowmo
	# inputs
	for i: int in range(2):
		var f: Fighter = fighters[i]
		f.prev_input = f.input
		var inp: Dictionary = {}
		for k: String in INPUT_KEYS:
			inp[k] = false
		if phase == "fighting":
			if ai[i] != null:
				if mode == "training" and i == 1 and dummy_mode != 0:
					inp = ai[i].blank()
					if dummy_mode == 2:
						inp["block"] = true
				else:
					inp = ai[i].tick(sdt, projectiles)
			else:
				inp = _keys_p1() if i == 0 else _keys_p2()
				if i == 0:
					inp = _merge(inp, touch.state)
		if not (test_input[i] as Dictionary).is_empty():
			inp = _merge(inp, test_input[i])
		f.input = inp
	# hitstop / slowmo
	if hitstop > 0.0:
		hitstop -= dt
		for f: Fighter in fighters:
			f.queue_redraw()
	else:
		for f: Fighter in fighters:
			f.tick(sdt)
		for i: int in range(projectiles.size() - 1, -1, -1):
			var p: Projectile = projectiles[i]
			p.tick(sdt)
			if p.dead:
				p.queue_free()
				projectiles.remove_at(i)
		_check_hits(fighters, sdt, false)
		_spawn_projectiles()
	fx.tick(dt)
	# phases
	match phase:
		"intro":
			if phase_t > 1.3 and phase_t - dt <= 1.3:
				hud.say("FIGHT!", 0.9, Color(1, 0.3, 0.3))
				sfx.play("bell")
			if phase_t > 1.6:
				phase = "fighting"
				for f: Fighter in fighters:
					f.set_state("idle")
		"fighting":
			if not hud.infinite_time:
				timer = maxf(0.0, timer - sdt)
				hud.timer = timer
				if timer <= 0.0:
					hud.say("TIME!", 1.2, Color(1, 0.9, 0.3))
					sfx.play("bell3")
					var w: int = -1
					if fighters[0].hp > fighters[1].hp:
						w = 0
					elif fighters[1].hp > fighters[0].hp:
						w = 1
					_end_round(w)
			if mode == "training":
				var quiet: bool = not fighters[0].in_hitstun() and not fighters[1].in_hitstun()
				if quiet:
					regen_t += dt
				else:
					regen_t = 0.0
				if regen_t > 2.5:
					for f: Fighter in fighters:
						f.hp = minf(f.max_hp, f.hp + 40.0 * dt)
			for i: int in range(2):
				if fighters[i].hp <= 0.0 and mode != "training":
					phase = "ko"
					phase_t = 0.0
					slowmo = 0.25
					hud.say("K.O.!", 1.5, Color(1, 0.3, 0.3))
					sfx.play("ko")
					sfx.play("dizzy", -6.0)
					shake = 22.0
					stage.hype = 1.0
					_schedule_round_end(1 - i)
				elif fighters[i].hp <= 0.0 and mode == "training":
					fighters[i].hp = 1.0
		"ko":
			if phase_t > 1.1:
				slowmo = 1.0
			if phase_t > 1.9:
				_end_round(result_pending)
		"roundend":
			if phase_t > 2.4:
				if rounds_won[0] >= 2 or rounds_won[1] >= 2:
					_fight_over(0 if rounds_won[0] >= 2 else 1)
				else:
					round_no += 1
					_start_round()
		"done":
			for f: Fighter in fighters:
				if f.state == "win" and randf() < dt * 1.5:

func _update_camera(dt: float) -> void:
	var a: Fighter = fighters[0]
	var b: Fighter = fighters[1]
	var mid: Vector2 = (a.pos + b.pos) * 0.5
	var dist: float = absf(a.pos.x - b.pos.x)
	var need: float = dist * 0.5 + 330.0
	var vs: Vector2 = get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size
	var z: float = clampf((vs.x * 0.5) / need, 0.62, 0.92)
	var target_zoom: Vector2 = Vector2(z, z)
	cam.zoom = cam.zoom.lerp(target_zoom, 1.0 - exp(-dt * 4.0))
	var half_w: float = vs.x * 0.5 / cam.zoom.x
	var tx: float = clampf(mid.x, -1500.0 + half_w, 1500.0 - half_w)
	var top_y: float = minf(a.pos.y, b.pos.y)
	var ty: float = minf(-230.0 / cam.zoom.y * 1.0, top_y * 0.6 - 230.0)
	var target: Vector2 = Vector2(tx, ty)
	cam.position = cam.position.lerp(target, 1.0 - exp(-dt * 6.0))
	if shake > 0.0:
		shake = maxf(0.0, shake - dt * 60.0)
		cam.offset = Vector2(randf_range(-shake, shake), randf_range(-shake, shake))
	else:
		cam.offset = Vector2.ZERO

func _spawn_projectiles() -> void:
	for f: Fighter in fighters:
		if f.state == "attack" and f.attack.get("projectile", false) and not f.projectile_spawned and f.state_t >= float(f.attack.get("spawn_t", 0.2)):
			f.projectile_spawned = true
			var p: Projectile = Projectile.new()
			var start: Vector2 = f.limb_world("rh")
			if f.attack.get("ground_wave", false):
				start = f.pos + Vector2(60.0 * f.facing, 0)
				shake = maxf(shake, 10.0)
				fx.dust(f.pos, 12, 90.0)
				fx.ring(f.pos + Vector2(40.0 * f.facing, -20), f.data["accent"], 200.0)
			else:
				fx.spark(start, f.data["accent"], false)
			p.setup(f, f.attack, start)
			world.add_child(p)
			projectiles.append(p)

func _seg_dist(p: Vector2, a: Vector2, b: Vector2) -> float:
	var ab: Vector2 = b - a
	var t: float = clampf((p - a).dot(ab) / maxf(0.001, ab.length_squared()), 0.0, 1.0)
	return p.distance_to(a + ab * t)

func _check_hits(fs: Array, dt: float, demo: bool) -> void:
	for f: Fighter in fs:
		if f.state != "attack":
			continue
		var a: Dictionary = f.attack
		var t: float = f.state_t
		var act: Array = a["active"]
		if t < float(act[0]) or t > float(act[1]):
			continue
		var multi: float = float(a.get("multihit", 0.0))
		if f.attack_hit and multi <= 0.0:
			continue
		if multi > 0.0 and f.last_multi_hit >= 0.0 and t - f.last_multi_hit < multi:
			continue
		var v: Fighter = f.opponent
		if v == null or not v.is_vulnerable():
			continue
		var point: Vector2 = f.limb_world(String(a["limb"]))
		var cap: Array = v.hurt_capsule()
		if _seg_dist(point, cap[0], cap[1]) <= float(cap[2]) + float(a["radius"]):
			_resolve_hit(f, v, a, point, demo)
	# projectiles
	if demo:
		return
	for i: int in range(projectiles.size() - 1, -1, -1):
		var p: Projectile = projectiles[i]
		var v: Fighter = p.owner_f.opponent
		if v == null or not v.is_vulnerable():
			continue
		var cap: Array = v.hurt_capsule()
		if _seg_dist(p.hit_point(), cap[0], cap[1]) <= float(cap[2]) + p.radius():
			_resolve_hit(p.owner_f, v, p.attack, p.hit_point(), false)
			p.dead = true
		# projectile vs projectile
		for j: int in range(i - 1, -1, -1):
			var q: Projectile = projectiles[j]
			if q.owner_f != p.owner_f and q.pos.distance_to(p.pos) < p.radius() + q.radius():
				p.dead = true
				q.dead = true
				fx.spark(p.pos, Color(1, 1, 1), true)
				fx.word(p.pos + Vector2(0, -60), "CLASH!", Color(0.9, 0.9, 1.0))
				sfx.play("zap")

func _resolve_hit(f: Fighter, v: Fighter, a: Dictionary, point: Vector2, demo: bool) -> void:
	var multi: float = float(a.get("multihit", 0.0))
	var last: bool = true
	if multi > 0.0:
		f.last_multi_hit = f.state_t
		f.multi_hits += 1
		last = f.state_t + multi > float(a["active"][1])
	f.attack_hit = true
	var res: Dictionary = v.take_hit(a, f, point, last)
	var special: bool = a.get("kind", "") == "special"
	if res["blocked"]:
		fx.block_spark(point)
		sfx.play_var("block", -4.0)
		hitstop = maxf(hitstop, 0.04)
		if not demo:
			fx.word(point + Vector2(0, -70), "BLOCK!", Color(0.6, 0.85, 1.0), 0.7)
		return
	var big: bool = special or bool(a.get("launch", false)) or bool(a.get("knockdown", false))
	fx.spark(point, f.data["accent"], big)
	var words: Array = Roster.SPECIAL_WORDS if special else Roster.HIT_WORDS
	if not demo or randf() < 0.5:
		fx.word(point + Vector2(randf_range(-30, 30), -80), words[randi() % words.size()], Color(1, 0.9, 0.3) if not special else f.data["accent"], 1.3 if big else 1.0)
	sfx.play_var(String(a.get("snd", "punch1")), 0.0)
	if big:
		sfx.play("bonk", -4.0)
		sfx.play("ooh", -8.0)
	hitstop = maxf(hitstop, 0.12 if big else 0.06)
	shake = maxf(shake, 16.0 if big else 6.0)
	stage.hype = minf(1.0, stage.hype + (0.6 if big else 0.25))
	if a.get("spin", false):
		fx.speedlines(point, f.facing, f.data["accent"])
	if v.hp <= 0.0 and not demo:
		fx.ring(point, Color(1, 1, 1), 400.0)
		fx.spark(point, Color(1, 1, 1), true)
	elif f.combo_count == 3 and not demo:
		fx.word(v.head_world() + Vector2(0, -140), "COMBO!", Color(1.0, 0.6, 0.1), 1.1)
	if f.meter >= 50.0 and f.meter - 8.0 < 50.0 and not demo:
		sfx.play("meter", -6.0)

func _spawn_ped(x: float, boss: bool) -> Fighter:
	var idx: int
	if boss:
		idx = 8
	else:
		idx = randi() % 8
		var tries: int = 0
		while (idx == p1_choice or _ped_with_id(idx) != null) and tries < 20:
			idx = randi() % 8
			tries += 1
	var f: Fighter = Fighter.new()
	f.setup(Roster.FIGHTERS[idx], 1)
	f.wall = STREET_WALL
	f.is_ai = true
	f.z_index = 5
	world.add_child(f)
	f.reset_round(clampf(x, -STREET_WALL + 100.0, STREET_WALL - 100.0), 1 if randf() < 0.5 else -1)
	f.set_state("idle")
	f.hp = f.max_hp
	peds.append(f)
	street_wander[f] = {"tx": f.pos.x, "wait": randf_range(0.5, 2.0), "leaving": false, "boss": boss, "beaten": false}
	return f

func _ped_with_id(idx: int) -> Fighter:
	for f: Fighter in peds:
		if f.data["id"] == Roster.FIGHTERS[idx]["id"]:
			return f
	return null

func _ped_input(f: Fighter, dt: float) -> Dictionary:
	var inp: Dictionary = {}
	for k: String in INPUT_KEYS:
		inp[k] = false
	var w: Dictionary = street_wander[f]
	if f == street_target and street_state != "walk":
		return inp
	if bool(w["boss"]) and not bool(w["beaten"]) and street_state == "walk":
		# the boss marches straight at the player
		w["tx"] = player.pos.x
	elif street_state in ["taunt", "cloud", "fighting"] and f != street_target:
		# scatter away from the brawl and watch from the sides
		var cx: float = player.pos.x
		var side: float = -1.0 if f.pos.x < cx else 1.0
		w["tx"] = clampf(cx + side * randf_range(620.0, 820.0), -STREET_WALL + 80.0, STREET_WALL - 80.0) if absf(f.pos.x - cx) < 560.0 else f.pos.x
	elif bool(w["leaving"]):
		w["tx"] = sign(f.pos.x - player.pos.x) * (STREET_WALL + 400.0) if f.pos.x != player.pos.x else STREET_WALL + 400.0
	else:
		w["wait"] = float(w["wait"]) - dt
		if float(w["wait"]) <= 0.0:
			w["wait"] = randf_range(1.0, 4.0)
			w["tx"] = clampf(f.pos.x + randf_range(-500.0, 500.0), -STREET_WALL + 80.0, STREET_WALL - 80.0)
	var dx: float = float(w["tx"]) - f.pos.x
	if absf(dx) > 24.0:
		inp["right" if dx > 0.0 else "left"] = true
	# watchers hop and cheer
	if street_state == "fighting" and f != street_target and absf(dx) <= 24.0 and f.on_ground and randf() < dt * 0.6:
		inp["up"] = true
	return inp

func _street_taunt() -> void:
	# nearest pedestrian in front within reach
	var best: Fighter = null
	var bd: float = 260.0
	for f: Fighter in peds:
		if bool(street_wander[f]["leaving"]):
			continue
		var d: float = absf(f.pos.x - player.pos.x)
		if d < bd:
			bd = d
			best = f
	if best == null:
		player.say(["HEY! ANYONE?", "NOBODY HERE...", "COME BACK!"][randi() % 3], 1.0)
		sfx.play("click")
		return
	street_target = best
	street_state = "taunt"
	street_t = 0.0
	street_target.z_index = 7
	player.say(["HEY YOU! WANNA BRAWL?", "YOU! ME! RIGHT NOW!", "THINK YOU'RE TOUGH?", "LET'S GO, BUDDY!"][randi() % 4], 1.3)
	player.facing = 1 if best.pos.x >= player.pos.x else -1
	sfx.play("ding")

func _street_begin_fight() -> void:
	var t: Fighter = street_target
	var cx: float = fx.cloud_pos().x
	player.hidden_in_cloud = false
	t.hidden_in_cloud = false
	player.pos = Vector2(cx - 110.0, 0)
	t.pos = Vector2(cx + 110.0, 0)
	player.vel = Vector2.ZERO
	t.vel = Vector2.ZERO
	player.set_state("idle")
	t.set_state("idle")
	player.opponent = t
	t.opponent = player
	player.meter = minf(100.0, player.meter + 25.0)
	t.meter = 30.0
	var diff: float = clampf(0.3 + street_score * 0.08, 0.3, 0.95)
	if bool(street_wander[t]["boss"]):
		diff = 0.9
	else:
		t.hp = t.max_hp * clampf(0.7 + street_score * 0.05, 0.7, 1.0)
	ai[1] = FighterAI.new(t, diff)
	fighters = [player, t]
	hud.p2 = t
	hud.show_p2 = true
	hud.shown_hp = [player.hp, t.hp]
	hud.say("FIGHT!", 0.9, Color(1, 0.3, 0.3))
	sfx.play("bell")
	sfx.play_music("music_fight2" if bool(street_wander[t]["boss"]) else "music_fight")
	street_state = "fighting"
	street_t = 0.0
	touch.special_label = "SPECIAL"
	touch.queue_redraw()
	fx.items = fx.items.filter(func(it: Dictionary) -> bool: return it["k"] != "cloud")

func _street_end_fight(won: bool) -> void:
	var t: Fighter = street_target
	ai[1] = null
	fighters = [player]
	hud.show_p2 = false
	hud.p2 = player
	t.z_index = 5
	if won:
		street_score += 1
		hud.street_score = street_score
		street_best = maxi(street_best, street_score)
		_save()
		street_state = "won"
		street_t = 0.0
		var w: Dictionary = street_wander[t]
		w["beaten"] = true
		hud.say("YOU WIN!  +1", 1.4, Color(1, 0.9, 0.3))
		player.set_state("win")
		player.hp = minf(player.max_hp, player.hp + 30.0)
		sfx.play("cheer")
		fx.confetti(player.pos + Vector2(0, -220), 30)
		stage.hype = 1.0
		sfx.play_music("music_menu")
	else:
		street_state = "lost"
		street_t = 0.0
		hud.say("BONKED!", 1.6, Color(1, 0.4, 0.3))
		t.set_state("win")
		t.say(["HA! TOO EASY!", "NICE TRY, BUDDY!", "SEE YA!"][randi() % 3], 2.0)
		sfx.play_music("music_lose", false)

func _update_street(dt: float) -> void:
	if player == null:
		return
	if paused:
		touch.queue_redraw()
		return
	stage.tick(dt)
	street_t += dt
	var sdt: float = dt * slowmo
	# player input
	player.prev_input = player.input
	var inp: Dictionary = {}
	for k: String in INPUT_KEYS:
		inp[k] = false
	if street_state in ["walk", "fighting"]:
		inp = _merge(_keys_p1(), touch.state)
		if not (test_input[0] as Dictionary).is_empty():
			inp = _merge(inp, test_input[0])
		if street_state == "walk" and bool(inp["special"]) and not bool(player.prev_input.get("special", false)):
			inp["special"] = false
			_street_taunt()
		elif street_state == "walk":
			inp["special"] = false
	player.input = inp
	# ped inputs
	for f: Fighter in peds:
		f.prev_input = f.input
		if street_state == "fighting" and f == street_target:
			f.input = ai[1].tick(sdt, projectiles) if ai[1] != null else _ped_input(f, dt)
			if not (test_input[1] as Dictionary).is_empty():
				f.input = _merge(f.input, test_input[1])
		elif f.in_hitstun() or f.state in ["win", "lose", "ko"]:
			f.input = inp.duplicate()
			for k: String in INPUT_KEYS:
				f.input[k] = false
		else:
			f.input = _ped_input(f, dt)
	# tick
	if hitstop > 0.0:
		hitstop -= dt
		player.queue_redraw()
	else:
		if not player.hidden_in_cloud:
			player.tick(sdt)
		for f: Fighter in peds:
			if not f.hidden_in_cloud:
				f.tick(sdt)
		for i: int in range(projectiles.size() - 1, -1, -1):
			var p: Projectile = projectiles[i]
			p.tick(sdt)
			if p.dead:
				p.queue_free()
				projectiles.remove_at(i)
		if street_state == "fighting":
			_check_hits([player, street_target], sdt, false)
			_spawn_projectiles()
	fx.tick(dt)
	# walking: bump bubbles
	match street_state:
		"walk":
			for f: Fighter in peds:
				if absf(f.pos.x - player.pos.x) < 150.0 and f.bubble_t <= 0.0 and randf() < dt * 0.5:
					var w: Dictionary = street_wander[f]
					if bool(w["boss"]) and not bool(w["beaten"]):
						f.say("YOU! ME! NOW!", 1.5)
						if absf(f.pos.x - player.pos.x) < 200.0 and street_t > 1.0:
							street_target = f
							street_state = "taunt"
							street_t = 0.6
							player.facing = 1 if f.pos.x >= player.pos.x else -1
					elif bool(w["beaten"]):
						f.say(["NOT AGAIN...", "I'M GOING HOME", "OUCH"][randi() % 3], 1.2)
					else:
						f.say(["NICE DAY!", "HI THERE!", "WATCH IT!", "SUP?", "COOL GLOVES"][randi() % 5], 1.2)
			# recycle pedestrians that left
			for i: int in range(peds.size() - 1, -1, -1):
				var f: Fighter = peds[i]
				if bool(street_wander[f]["leaving"]) and (absf(f.pos.x - player.pos.x) > 1500.0 or absf(f.pos.x) >= STREET_WALL - 5.0):
					street_wander.erase(f)
					peds.remove_at(i)
					f.queue_free()
					var side: float = 1.0 if player.facing == 1 else -1.0
					_spawn_ped(player.pos.x + side * randf_range(900.0, 1300.0), false)
			# boss every 5 wins
			if street_score > 0 and street_score % 5 == 0 and _ped_with_id(8) == null and last_boss_score != street_score:
				last_boss_score = street_score
				var b: Fighter = _spawn_ped(player.pos.x + (1300.0 if player.facing == 1 else -1300.0), true)
				b.say("WHERE'S THAT BRAWLER?!", 2.0)
				hud.say("KING KNUCKLE IS COMING!", 1.6, Color(1, 0.85, 0.2))
				sfx.play("bell3")
		"taunt":
			var t: Fighter = street_target
			t.facing = 1 if player.pos.x >= t.pos.x else -1
			if street_t > 0.9 and street_t - dt <= 0.9:
				t.say(["YOU'RE ON!", "OH IT'S ON!", "BIG MISTAKE!", "LET'S DANCE!"][randi() % 4], 1.0)
				sfx.play("ooh", -6.0)
			if street_t > 1.8:
				# both dive into the dust cloud
				street_state = "cloud"
				street_t = 0.0
				var cx: float = (player.pos.x + t.pos.x) * 0.5
				player.hidden_in_cloud = true
				t.hidden_in_cloud = true
				fx.cloud(Vector2(cx, 0), player.data["glove"], t.data["glove"], 2.4)
				hud.say("BRAWL!", 1.1, Color(1.0, 0.6, 0.2))
				sfx.play("whoosh_big")
				sfx.play("cheer", -4.0)
				shake = 10.0
		"cloud":
			var cp: Vector2 = fx.cloud_pos()
			cp.x += sin(street_t * 5.0) * 260.0 * dt
			fx.move_cloud(cp)
			if fmod(street_t, 0.22) < dt:
				sfx.play_var(["punch1", "punch2", "punch3", "bonk", "boing"][randi() % 5], -3.0)
				fx.word(cp + Vector2(randf_range(-160, 160), randf_range(-260, -120)), Roster.HIT_WORDS[randi() % Roster.HIT_WORDS.size()], Color(1, 0.9, 0.3), 0.9)
				fx.dust(cp, 4, 120.0)
				shake = maxf(shake, 5.0)
			if street_t > 2.3:
				_street_begin_fight()
		"fighting":
			var t: Fighter = street_target
			if t.hp <= 0.0 or player.hp <= 0.0:
				var won: bool = t.hp <= 0.0
				hud.say("K.O.!", 1.2, Color(1, 0.3, 0.3))
				sfx.play("ko")
				shake = 20.0
				slowmo = 0.3
				street_state = "ko"
				street_t = 0.0
				result_pending = 1 if won else 0
		"ko":
			if street_t > 0.9:
				slowmo = 1.0
			if street_t > 1.5:
				_street_end_fight(result_pending == 1)
		"won":
			var t: Fighter = street_target
			if street_t > 1.6 and street_t - dt <= 1.6:
				t.set_state("getup")
				t.hp = t.max_hp
				t.say(["OK OK YOU WIN!", "I GIVE UP!", "WOW, YOU'RE GOOD!", "MY GLOVES SLIPPED!"][randi() % 4], 1.8)
			if street_t > 2.6:
				player.set_state("idle")
				player.opponent = null
				t.opponent = null
				street_wander[t]["leaving"] = true
				street_target = null
				street_state = "walk"
				street_t = 0.0
				touch.special_label = "TAUNT"
				touch.queue_redraw()
		"lost":
			if street_t > 2.4:
				phase = "done"
				_show_result("STREET BRAWL OVER", "Brawls won: %d   ·   Record: %d" % [street_score, street_best], false)
				street_state = "done"
		"done":
			pass
	hud.street_hint = street_state == "walk" and street_score == 0
	# camera
	_update_street_camera(dt)
	hud.tick(dt)
	stage.cam = cam.position

func _boss_beaten_this_tier() -> bool:
	for f: Fighter in peds:
		if f.data["id"] == "king":
			return true
	return false

func _update_street_camera(dt: float) -> void:
	var vs: Vector2 = get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size
	var target: Vector2
	var tz: float = 0.85
	if street_state in ["fighting", "ko"] and street_target != null:
		var mid: Vector2 = (player.pos + street_target.pos) * 0.5
		var dist: float = absf(player.pos.x - street_target.pos.x)
		tz = clampf((vs.x * 0.5) / (dist * 0.5 + 330.0), 0.62, 0.92)
		target = Vector2(mid.x, minf(player.pos.y, street_target.pos.y) * 0.6 - 230.0)
	elif street_state == "cloud":
		target = Vector2(fx.cloud_pos().x, -230.0)
		tz = 0.9
	else:
		target = Vector2(player.pos.x + 160.0 * player.facing, player.pos.y * 0.5 - 250.0)
	cam.zoom = cam.zoom.lerp(Vector2(tz, tz), 1.0 - exp(-dt * 3.0))
	var half_w: float = vs.x * 0.5 / cam.zoom.x
	target.x = clampf(target.x, -STREET_WALL - 200.0 + half_w, STREET_WALL + 200.0 - half_w)
	cam.position = cam.position.lerp(target, 1.0 - exp(-dt * 5.0))
	if shake > 0.0:
		shake = maxf(0.0, shake - dt * 60.0)
		cam.offset = Vector2(randf_range(-shake, shake), randf_range(-shake, shake))
	else:
		cam.offset = Vector2.ZERO

## Energy fist (fireball) or ground shockwave.

var max_life: float = 1.6

var pos: Vector2 = Vector2.ZERO

func setup(f: Fighter, a: Dictionary, p: Vector2) -> void:
	owner_f = f
	attack = a
	dir = f.facing
	pos = p
	color = f.data["accent"]
	if a.get("ground_wave", false):
		kind = "shock"
		spd = 520.0
		max_life = 1.3
		pos.y = 0.0
	z_index = 6

func tick(dt: float) -> void:
	life += dt
	pos.x += spd * dir * dt
	position = pos
	trail.append(pos)
	if trail.size() > 14:
		trail.pop_front()
	if life >= max_life or absf(pos.x) > 900.0:
		dead = true
	queue_redraw()

func hit_point() -> Vector2:
	return pos

func radius() -> float:
	return 34.0 if kind == "fireball" else 46.0

func _draw() -> void:
	var t: float = life
	if kind == "fireball":
		for i: int in range(trail.size()):
			var a: float = float(i) / trail.size()
			var tp: Vector2 = trail[i] - pos
			draw_circle(tp, 8.0 + a * 18.0, Color(color.r, color.g, color.b, 0.25 * a))
		draw_circle(Vector2.ZERO, 42.0, Color(color.r, color.g, color.b, 0.3))
		draw_circle(Vector2.ZERO, 30.0, color)
		draw_circle(Vector2.ZERO, 20.0, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.9))
		# fist shape
		draw_set_transform(Vector2.ZERO, 0.0, Vector2(dir, 1))
		draw_circle(Vector2(6, 0), 15.0, Color(0.1, 0.05, 0.1))
		draw_circle(Vector2(6, 0), 12.0, color.lightened(0.2))
		draw_rect(Rect2(Vector2(-6, -10), Vector2(16, 20)), color.lightened(0.2))
		for k: int in range(4):
			draw_circle(Vector2(14, -8 + k * 5.5), 3.2, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.7))
		draw_set_transform(Vector2.ZERO, 0.0, Vector2.ONE)
		# sparkles
		for k: int in range(5):
			var ang: float = t * 14.0 + k * TAU / 5.0
			var sp: Vector2 = Vector2(cos(ang), sin(ang)) * (34.0 + sin(t * 20.0 + k) * 6.0)
			draw_circle(sp, 4.0, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.8))
	else:
		# shockwave: a rolling hump of ground with debris
		var h: float = 46.0 + sin(t * 30.0) * 4.0
		var pts: PackedVector2Array = PackedVector2Array()
		for i: int in range(13):
			var f: float = float(i) / 12.0
			var x: float = -60.0 + f * 120.0
			var y: float = -sin(f * PI) * h
			pts.append(Vector2(x, y))
		pts.append(Vector2(60, 0))
		pts.append(Vector2(-60, 0))
		draw_colored_polygon(pts, Color(0.1, 0.05, 0.1))
		var inner: PackedVector2Array = PackedVector2Array()
		for v: Vector2 in pts:
			inner.append(Vector2(v.x * 0.9, v.y * 0.86))
		draw_colored_polygon(inner, color)
		for k: int in range(7):
			var ang: float = t * 9.0 + k * 1.1
			var dp: Vector2 = Vector2(cos(ang) * 50.0, -absf(sin(ang * 1.3)) * 70.0 - 10.0)
			draw_rect(Rect2(dp, Vector2(9, 9)), Color(0.45, 0.3, 0.2))
		draw_arc(Vector2(0, 0), 70.0 + fmod(t * 300.0, 60.0), PI, TAU, 16, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.5), 4.0)

class_name Stage

## Procedural parallax backgrounds. Floor is y = 0, fighters stand between x = -700..700.

var data: Dictionary = {}
var cam: Vector2 = Vector2.ZERO
var t: float = 0.0
var crowd_seed: int = 3
var hype: float = 0.0

func setup(d: Dictionary) -> void:
	data = d
	z_index = 0
	t = 0.0

func tick(dt: float) -> void:
	t += dt
	hype = maxf(0.0, hype - dt * 0.6)
	queue_redraw()

func px(f: float) -> float:
	return cam.x * (1.0 - f)

func sky(top: Color, bot: Color) -> void:
	var x0: float = cam.x - 1500.0
	var w: float = 3000.0
	var bands: int = 10
	for i: int in range(bands):
		var f: float = float(i) / bands
		var y0: float = -1100.0 + f * 1100.0
		draw_rect(Rect2(x0, y0, w, 1100.0 / bands + 2.0), top.lerp(bot, f))

func ground(c: Color) -> void:
	draw_rect(Rect2(cam.x - 1500.0, 0.0, 3000.0, 700.0), c)
	draw_rect(Rect2(cam.x - 1500.0, 0.0, 3000.0, 6.0), c.darkened(0.35))

func _draw() -> void:
	if data.is_empty():
		return
	match String(data.get("id", "towers")):
		"towers": _draw_towers()
		"dojo": _draw_dojo()
		"beach": _draw_beach()
		"neon": _draw_neon()
		"street": _draw_street()
		_: _draw_arena()

func _rng(i: int) -> float:
	return fmod(sin(float(i) * 127.1 + crowd_seed * 311.7) * 43758.5453, 1.0)

func _draw_towers() -> void:
	sky(data["sky_top"], data["sky_bot"])
	# sun

	# skyline
	for i: int in range(14):

		draw_rect(Rect2(bx, -230.0 - bh, 70.0, bh), Color(0.25, 0.1, 0.3))

import os, re, math
wasm = open('index.wasm', 'rb').read()
part = 14 * 1024 * 1024
n = math.ceil(len(wasm) / part)
for i in range(n):
    open('index.part%d.wasm' % (i + 1), 'wb').write(wasm[i * part:(i + 1) * part])
os.remove('index.wasm')
os.rename('index.pck', 'index.pck.wasm')
html = open('index.html', encoding='utf-8').read()
html = html.replace('__WASM_PARTS__', str(n))
# strip document skeleton: the artifact host wraps the page itself
m = re.search(r'<head>(.*?)</head>', html, re.S)
head = m.group(1) if m else ''
m2 = re.search(r'<body[^>]*>(.*?)</body>', html, re.S)
body = m2.group(1) if m2 else html
head = re.sub(r'<title>.*?</title>', '', head, flags=re.S)
out = '<title>Knuckle Kings</title>\n' + head.strip() + '\n' + body.strip() + '\n'
open('index.html', 'w', encoding='utf-8').write(out)
print('parts:', n, 'html bytes:', len(out))
EOF
